description.text: Have a green idea but not sure where to start? ClimateLaunchpad is a free space to explore, test, and shape your concept with expert guidance.

targetApplicants.text: The top teams chosen by our National Leads take part in the ClimateLaunchpad National programme which kicks off with a multi-day digital Boot Camp.
